question: What three-part economic strategy defined India’s policy changes in the 1990s?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Liberalisation, Privatisation and Globalisation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The three-part economic strategy of **Liberalisation, Privatisation, and Globalisation (LPG)** was introduced in India in 1991 under the leadership of then-Prime Minister **P.V. Narasimha Rao** and Finance Minister **Dr. Manmohan Singh**.
